live.voiceDesc: Voices used for live announcements, TTS or voice clone
live.eventDesc: Viewer enter, like, comment and other interactions
live.eventEmpty: No interactions yet. They are recorded once streaming and the comment monitor are running
live.talkHistoryDesc: What was actually spoken during live streams
live.kb.desc: Scripts for automatic announcements and replies during live streams
live.kb.empty: Nothing here yet. Click Add at the top right
live.kb.flowTalkDesc: Spoken in turn when no viewer interaction happens, e.g. selling points and offers
live.kb.userDesc: Auto reply when a comment contains a keyword, e.g. reply with the price to "how much"
live.kb.systemDesc: Fixed responses when viewers enter, like, follow or send gifts
live.kb.flowVideoDesc: Product videos played in turn on the live screen
live.kb.title: Name
live.kb.keywordsHelp: Triggered when a comment contains any keyword; when several match, the longer keyword wins
live.kb.talksHelpFlow: One is picked at random each time; several variants sound more natural.
live.kb.aiNeedFirstTalk: Enter one script first; AI writes variants of it
live.kb.videoHelp: Copied into the app data folder on save
live.kb.censorWarn: These items contain banned words and may get the stream warned or limited
live.kb.blackWordConfigHelp: Comma separated. Scripts containing banned words are skipped during live streams.
live.consoleDesc: Start streaming, insert announcements, watch the queue
live.started: Live started; the live screen window is open
live.stopConfirm: Stop the live stream? Queued announcements will be cleared
live.checkFailed: Not ready yet; fix the items in the notice first
live.checkVoice: Select a live voice (add one under Live Voices)
live.checkFlowTalk: Add at least one enabled loop script in the knowledge base
live.checkAvatar: Select an avatar (add an avatar video under Avatars)
live.checkVideos: Product video mode needs loop videos in the knowledge base
live.avatarLipHint: The avatar video loops for now and lips do not follow the voice; real-time lip sync comes later
live.videoSoundHint: Muted by default so it does not mix with announcements
live.subtitle: Subtitles
live.manualSayPlaceholder: Type and press Enter; it plays before loop scripts
live.simulateDesc: Test keyword replies and welcomes before comments are connected
live.stageEmpty: Live screen: select an avatar or product videos in the console
live.howToTitle: Going live with Douyin Live Companion
live.howTo1: Click Start live; an "AigcPanel 直播画面" window opens. Do not minimize it
live.howTo2: In Douyin Live Companion add a Window source, pick "AigcPanel 直播画面" and fill the canvas
live.howTo3: Enable system audio capture and mute the microphone
live.howTo4: Go live; viewer interactions appear under Interactions and replies jump ahead of loop scripts
live.monitorDesc: Opens the live room page and reads enters, likes, comments, follows and gifts. You may need to log in to Douyin in that window first
live.roomUrlPlaceholder: Live room URL or share link, e.g. https://live.douyin.com/123456789
live.monitorNotLive: Not live yet: interactions are recorded but not answered
live.llmReply: Answer unmatched comments with an LLM
live.llmReplyHint: Answers from the knowledge base; replies are checked against banned words and unknown facts are not invented
live.llmModelHint: Configure an LLM in Settings first
live.llmVarKnowledge: Live material (built from the knowledge base)
live.checkLlmModel: LLM replies are on; select an LLM (configure one in Settings first)
